name: agent_simlingo_cluster_command_cfg_1_5_bench2drive
description: A benchmark of simulated natural-language driving commands and corresponding agent behaviors designed to evaluate command understanding and execution in autonomous-driving or agent simulation settings. It measures an agent's ability to parse, cluster, and follow text commands into correct action sequences under varied configurations. Tasks emphasize instruction understanding, command clustering, and action prediction.
reputation: A niche dataset with limited adoption so far, mainly used in simulation and agent-research experiments.
